sentences.zh: 没有水，也没有食物。

sentences.en: That's not human.

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Karin Demersian on what's led to the stunning delays and Michael Gold on the increasingly urgent negotiations in Congress to bring this crisis to an end.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事卡琳·德梅尔西安将探讨导致这些惊人延误的原因，迈克尔··戈德则将讨论国会为结束这场危机而日益紧迫的谈判。

sentences.en: Is there anyone that you feel like is responsible for this situation?
sentences.zh: 你觉得有人对这种情况负有责任吗？

sentences.en: Certainly the politicians.
sentences.zh: 当然是政客们。

sentences.en: The government, for sure.
sentences.zh: 政府，绝对是的。

sentences.en: Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: I think it is a failure of our government.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们政府的失败。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月26日，星期四。

sentences.en: Karin, you are based in Washington, D.C., where it finally seems like these obscene airport security line wait times are finally bringing lawmakers to the negotiating table,
sentences.zh: 卡琳，你常驻华盛顿特区，在那里，这些令人发指的机场安检排队等待时间似乎终于把议员们拉到了谈判桌前，

sentences.en: which we are going to talk about with our colleague on Capitol Hill,
sentences.zh: 我们将与国会山的同事

sentences.en: Michael Gold, in the second half of this episode.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·戈德在本集节目的后半部分讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: Let's begin with you and the misery at these airports and why it's become so acute over the past few days and at a few airports, just a full-blown crisis.
sentences.zh: 让我们从你以及这些机场的悲惨状况开始，为什么在过去几天里情况变得如此严重，并在少数机场演变成一场全面危机？

sentences.en: Well, in short, you can't shut down the Department of Homeland Security indefinitely without starting to see failures happen in the system.
sentences.zh: 嗯，简而言之，你不可能无限期地关停国土安全部，却不让系统开始出现故障。

sentences.en: And when it comes to the TSA, that's a workforce of 50,000 people who have been working unpaid for the last month and a half, basically.
sentences.zh: 说到美国运输安全管理局（TSA），那是一支由5万人组成的劳动力队伍，他们基本上在过去的一个半月里一直在无薪工作。

sentences.en: They're, you know, really the front line of where we are seeing the effects of that shutdown play out and are having to survive this duration
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们确实是我们看到该关停影响显现的第一线，并且不得不熬过这段已经持续了一个半月的时间，

sentences.en: that has been going on for already a month and a half and have needed to start calling out of work because they have to find other sources of income to live in the interim.
sentences.zh: 并且不得不开始请假缺勤，因为他们在此期间必须寻找其他经济来源来谋生。

sentences.en: And that means you don't have the same workforce doing the job that is really important to anybody who's trying to get on a plane.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你没有相同的劳动力来做对任何想要登机的人来说都非常重要的工作。

sentences.en: Now, that breakdown is not just affecting the individual lay traveler citizen.
sentences.zh: 现在，这种崩溃不仅影响到单个的休闲旅客公民。

sentences.en: It's also started to affect other government functions.
sentences.zh: 它也开始影响其他政府职能。

sentences.en: You saw that in the response to the accident that happened at LaGuardia earlier this week, the National Transportation Safety Board investigates aviation incidents like this.
sentences.zh: 你在本周早些时候对拉瓜迪亚机场发生的事故的响应中看到了这一点，国家运输安全委员会负责调查此类航空事故。

sentences.en: And they couldn't actually get all their investigators to LaGuardia because they got stuck for hours in security lines and they had to try to wrangle them out of it.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上无法让所有的调查人员都到达拉瓜迪亚，因为他们在安检队伍中被困了几个小时，他们不得不设法把他们弄出来。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You've seen the administration, the Trump administration, deploy ICE officials, even though they are not really trained to be TSA screeners, to various airports around the country.
sentences.zh: 你已经看到政府，特朗普政府，在全国各地的各个机场部署了移民和海关执法局（ICE）官员，尽管他们并没有真正接受过作为TSA安检员的培训。

sentences.en: And then in places like Atlanta, I mean, we saw there was a viral social media clip of an electric violinist entertaining everybody standing in an interminably long line,
sentences.zh: 然后在像亚特兰大这样的地方，我的意思是，我们看到社交媒体上有一个病毒式传播的短片，是一名电小提琴手在无休止的长队中为所有人表演，

sentences.en: which some might have found entertaining and others might have found that much more annoying.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会觉得很有趣，而另一些人可能会觉得这更加烦人。

sentences.en: But this is the scene that's playing out in both official and unofficial and comical ways at these airports across the country as they face these record-long wait times.
sentences.zh: 但这就是全国各地机场在面临创纪录的长等待时间时，以官方、非官方和滑稽的方式上演的场景。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as you said, this really goes back to a shutdown, a very unique shutdown of a single agency.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这确实要追溯到一个关停，一个针对单一机构的非常独特的关停。

sentences.en: And this started, and we covered it almost every step of the way, with congressional Democrats seeking to defund the Department of Homeland Security
sentences.zh: 这一切开始于——我们几乎全程追踪了每一步——国会民主党人试图取消对国土安全部的拨款，

sentences.en: in the aftermath of the immigration crackdowns, especially in Minneapolis that killed two U.S.
sentences.zh: 在移民镇压行动之后，特别是在明尼阿波利斯造成两名美国公民死亡的事件之后，

sentences.en: citizens,
sentences.zh: 公民，

sentences.en: Renee Good and Alex Preddy.
sentences.zh: 雷妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷迪。

sentences.en: And this was never intended to hurt airport security workers,
sentences.zh: 这从来都不是为了伤害机场安检人员，

sentences.en: but of course the understanding is that it might and now it has.
sentences.zh: 但当然大家明白这可能会造成伤害，而现在它确实发生了。

sentences.en: A question I have is, why did it take so long for airports to devolve into this amount of chaos given that the shutdown's been going on for a fairly long time?
sentences.zh: 我有一个问题，既然关停已经持续了相当长一段时间，为什么机场花这么长时间才演变成这种混乱程度？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, the shutdown started in mid-February, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，关停开始于2月中旬，对吧？

sentences.en: And you're not going to feel the immediate effect of that because, you know, people don't get paid for every day's work.
sentences.zh: 而且你不会立即感受到它的影响，因为你知道，人们并不是每做一天工就拿一天的工资。

sentences.en: People get paid every two weeks or so, right?
sentences.zh: 人们大约每两周领一次工资，对吧？

sentences.en: And so the workers for TSA are on a similar schedule.
sentences.zh: 因此，TSA的员工也处于类似的薪酬周期。

sentences.en: They're going to start to feel the pain of it once the money isn't coming into their bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 一旦资金没有打入他们的银行账户，他们就会开始感到痛苦。

sentences.en: And TSA workers, you're talking about salaries that are around $50,000-ish.
sentences.zh: 对于TSA员工来说，你们说的是大约5万美元左右的薪水。

sentences.en: You know, that's not a lot of money to build up savings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这并不是一笔可以用来积攒储蓄的巨款。

sentences.en: And so what we're seeing is that these TSA workers are having to find sources of funding to get them through life and having to seek out other gigs here and there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的是，这些TSA员工不得不寻找资金来源来维持生计，不得不到处寻找其他零工。

sentences.en: You know, they're running out of the ability to feed their kids in some cases, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，在某些情况下，他们快要养活不起自己的孩子了，对吧？

sentences.en: And so you are seeing a pain on a personal level happen and them having to make on an individual basis cost-benefit analyses of, you know, do I show up for my job
sentences.zh: 因此，你看到痛苦在个人层面发生，他们必须在个体基础上进行成本效益分析，你知道的，我是不是该去上班，

sentences.en: knowing I will eventually get a paycheck for that once this shutdown ends or do I find money that I need now?
sentences.zh: 明知这次关停结束后我最终会拿到这份工作的薪水，还是去找我现在需要的钱？

sentences.en: Happening on a scale of several tens of thousands of people and it's concentrated in these areas that end up having more difficult cost-of-living sorts of situations
sentences.zh: 这种情况在数万人的规模上发生，并且集中在这些地区，与其他人相比，这些地区对更多的TSA员工来说具有更困难的生活成本状况。

sentences.en: for more of the TSA workers than others.
sentences.zh: 对于更多的TSA员工而言。

sentences.en: Just explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: How in certain areas, certain regions, and I assume certain airports, what seem like universal conditions of unpaid TSA workers is having greater repercussions.
sentences.zh: 在某些地区、某些区域，我猜还有某些机场，TSA员工无薪工作的普遍状况是如何产生更大反响的。

sentences.en: So there's two kind of factors to think about this.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有两个需要考虑的因素。

sentences.en: One is what is your cost of living in the area in which this airport is, right?
sentences.zh: 一个是这个机场所在地区的生活成本是多少，对吧？

sentences.en: JFK, it's a pretty expensive area, right?
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪国际机场（JFK），那是一个相当昂贵的地区，对吧？

sentences.en: And so when you're talking about bills that are piling up, those are pretty big bills.
sentences.zh: 所以当你在谈论堆积如山的账单时，那些都是相当大的账单。

sentences.en: But then think about places like Houston.
sentences.zh: 但再想想像休斯顿这样的地方。

sentences.en: Houston has been a persistent problem with the long security lines.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿的超长安检队伍一直是个长期存在的问题。

sentences.en: And Houston, it's a huge, huge metro area.
sentences.zh: 而在休斯顿，这是一个非常巨大的大都市区。

sentences.en: It's like 80 miles across, if not more, right?
sentences.zh: 它大约有80英里宽，甚至更多，对吧？

sentences.en: And so then the question becomes, well, okay, it's also gas in the car.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，好吧，还有汽车里的汽油。

sentences.en: It's also hours that I have to spend on the road not finding other sources of income to keep my family going.
sentences.zh: 还有我必须花在路上的时间，而无法寻找其他收入来源来维持我的家庭运转。

sentences.en: There's multiple factors that each TSA worker has to take into account when they're kind of determining what's the budget I have to meet in order to not go into so much debt
sentences.zh: 有多个因素是每个TSA员工在决定我必须满足什么预算才能不陷入如此多的债务时必须考虑的，

sentences.en: that I am risking eviction.
sentences.zh: 以至于我面临被驱逐的风险。

sentences.en: And what have you come to understand about the nature of these workers
sentences.zh: 你对这些员工请假并说

sentences.en: calling in and saying,
sentences.zh: “我不会去上班了”这一现象的性质有什么了解？

sentences.en: I'm not coming to work?
sentences.zh: 这是在休斯顿或生活成本昂贵的纽约等地有组织的吗？

sentences.en: Is this organized in places like Houston or in New York where cost of living is expensive?
sentences.zh: 还是人们只是出于自己的意愿做出这些财务决定并请假说我不能去上班了，然后这种情况像滚雪球一样不断叠加？

sentences.en: Or are people just of their own volition making these financial determinations and calling in and saying, I can't come to work and it just multiplies on top of itself?
sentences.zh: 所以代表TSA员工的工会将强烈回击任何关于这些是有组织的政治声明式的集体请假的暗示，

sentences.en: So the union that represents TSA workers will push back hard against any sort of suggestion that these are like organized political statement sort of call-outs
sentences.zh: 即人们打电话报告缺勤，相反，他们表示，你知道，这只是反映了在那些安检队伍最长的特定地区工作的所有人不得不经历的现实，

sentences.en: where people are calling in their absences and say instead that, you know, this is just reflecting the reality of what everybody who's working in those particular areas
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你在像休斯顿这样的地方看到某些日子的请假人数上升到40%以上。

sentences.en: that have seen the longest security lines is having to go through, which is why you've seen in places like Houston, the number of call-outs on certain days go up above 40%.
sentences.zh: 然后这直接转化为航空旅客的痛苦，对吧？

sentences.en: And then that is going to translate directly into pain for the airline traveler, right?
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪机场也是类似的情况。

sentences.en: Same sort of thing at JFK.
sentences.zh: 你已经看到请假人数持续超过30%。

sentences.en: You've seen call-out numbers consistently go above 30%.
sentences.zh: 那是一条很长很长的队伍。

sentences.en: That's a long, long line.
sentences.zh: 你之前提到过这一点。

sentences.en: You had mentioned this.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统决定引入ICE特工作为解决TSA员工请假短缺问题的方案。

sentences.en: President Trump decides to bring ICE agents in as a solution to the shortages of TSA workers calling out.
sentences.zh: 帮我们理解一下这个逻辑，以及它是否奏效。

sentences.en: Help us understand that logic and whether it's been working.
sentences.zh: 所以表面的逻辑是需要更多人手，就拥有更多人手。

sentences.en: So the logic ostensibly is need more bodies, have more bodies.
sentences.zh: 所以派他们去帮助TSA。

sentences.en: So send them to help out the TSA.
sentences.zh: 问题是并非所有人都相信这是真正的原因。

sentences.en: The problem is that not everybody believes that's the actual reason.
sentences.zh: 有很多怀疑认为他们实际上是在那里试图增强他们进行逮捕和驱逐的能力。

sentences.en: There's a lot of suspicion that actually they are there to try to augment their ability to do apprehensions and deportations.
sentences.zh: 总统确实说过，当他们被部署到机场时，他们仍然会履行这一职责。

sentences.en: And the president did say they were still going to be performing that role when they were deployed to airports.
sentences.zh: 然后是TSA，至少是工会代表，他们真的很不喜欢这样，因为他们基本上是在说，听着，这些人没有接受过做我们所做事情的培训。

sentences.en: And then the TSA, at least the, you know, reps in the union, they really don't like it because they are basically saying, look, these guys were not trained to do what we do.
sentences.zh: 公众在ICE官员身边感觉不到舒适。

sentences.en: The public does not feel comfortable around an ICE official.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，TSA实际上应该在进行安全检查时让你感到舒适。

sentences.en: The TSA is actually supposed to make you feel comfortable when they're doing your security screenings at the same time.
sentences.zh: 而且因为他们没有接受过这方面的培训，他们在大多数这些安检队伍中根本帮不上忙。

sentences.en: And because they weren't trained to do it, they can't actually help out in most of these security lines at all.
sentences.zh: 所以他们站在那里分发水，看起来好像他们正试图参与其中，但实际上并没有，你知道，仔细检查你的包或者让人们通过那些金属探测器。

sentences.en: So they stand there passing out water, looking like they're trying to be engaged, but not actually, you know, combing through your bags or getting people through those metals.
sentences.zh: 所以他们提供了什么帮助？

sentences.en: And so what help are they giving?
sentences.zh: 对于TSA来说，感觉就像是，你知道，雪上加霜，因为ICE官员正在拿到工资，因为去年国内政策法案中有数百亿美元的额外资金池

sentences.en: And for the TSA, it feels like, you know, added insult upon injury because ICE officials are getting paid because there was this pot of tens of billions of extra money
sentences.zh: 被用来支付ICE官员的工资，而TSA员工没有拿到工资，却仍然不得不接着干活。

sentences.en: in last year's domestic policy bill that has been used to pay ICE officials and the TSA workers are not being paid and still having to then do the work.
sentences.zh: 没错。
